correction04_retained: Narrowed conservation invariant: TERMINAL CommandJob => PRIMARY OWNED PGID GONE (was: ZERO LIVE ClineMM-OWNED DESCENDANTS).
Made probeOwnedGroups fail-closed: state is now { gone, alive, eperm, unknown }.
Moved the PGID postcondition probe from after terminal_committed into the synchronous span of finalize() BEFORE terminal_committed AND BEFORE active.delete(job.id).
correction05_retained: NEW P0 FIX: terminal_committed GATED on postcondition === 'gone'. Only 'gone' authorizes clean closure.
NEW P1 FIX: helper EPERM path renamed to command_job_helper_cleanup_attempted with helperOutcome: success|denied|failed.
correction06_applied: Added CommandJobState 'containment_failed' terminal class — explicit state for jobs whose execution ended but whose bounded PGID-conservation invariant was NOT proven. Distinct from exited/deadline_exceeded/cancelled/spawn_failed so consumers can read the verdict.

DEFERRED state assignment in finalize(): the caller's clean terminal state (e.g. 'cancelled') is OVERWRITTEN with 'containment_failed' on any non-gone postcondition. The bounded invariant CLEAN_TERMINAL CommandJob => PRIMARY OWNED PGID GONE then holds by construction: containment_failed jobs do NOT claim CLEAN_TERMINAL.
Added CommandJobSnapshot.containmentFailed projection — terminal jobs whose postcondition was non-gone expose the verdict out-of-band (mirror of CommandJob.terminationFailed).

Added command_job_containment_failed lifecycle event — fires AFTER active.delete on the failure path so the tracker decrements the gauge from N to N-1. Closes the stale-gauge bug correction05 introduced (the gauge stayed at N because terminal_committed was denied).

DCCT-11..14 strengthened to assert (a) snapshot.state is containment_failed on non-gone paths, (b) containmentFailed is set to substrate_alive/eperm/unknown, (c) command_job_containment_failed event fires AFTER active.delete with activeCommandJobs := 0.

honest_verdict_matrix_correction06.CONTAINMENT_FAILED_TERMINAL_CLASS: PROVEN — explicit CommandJobState member; populated via deferred state assignment in finalize(); projected into CommandJobSnapshot.containmentFailed
honest_verdict_matrix_correction06.GAUGE_CONSERVATION_ON_FAILURE_PATH: PROVEN — command_job_containment_failed fires AFTER active.delete so the tracker decrements N -> N-1 (the stale-gauge bug from correction05 is closed)

successor_act.rationale: Per Factory reviewer: prior PPID-walk mechanism is not established on macOS after reparenting (Apple distinguishes ppid from original_ppid). ACT must first discriminate candidate authority primitives (A: cleanup-time PPID/proc_pidinfo reconstruction, B: event-time fork lineage tracking from helper via EVFILT_PROC NOTE_FORK, C: native stable descendant authority via es_new_descendants_client) before freezing a mechanism.
